external_review._comment_alert: alert_if_missing: reserved (review is now interactive — never silently skipped)
external_review._comment_iterations: feedback_iterations: default 1 = external review is the default path. 0 = explicit opt-out; the consuming skill then runs a mandatory self-review ('2x denken') fallback instead. If > 0 and no API key is set, the skill interactively prompts the user.

models._comment: Identity-locked review models: DeepSeek always uses its OpenRouter model; GPT uses its OpenRouter or direct model. Runtime rejects config or environment overrides that differ from these exact identifiers.

deepseek_routing._comment: Fail closed: runtime requires this ordered declaration to match the code-owned approved endpoint registry. A future US/EU endpoint needs deliberate code, config, test, and review changes after its ZDR policy and processing region are verified.

llm_client._comment: Timeout and retry settings for external LLM calls
llm_client._comment_timeout: Kept at 240 seconds for the shared 16000-token review budget. Keep both review clients and this shipping value in lockstep.
